'''Ty Breely''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends| Rebel Alliance]]. He served as the technical expert at [[Titan Base]]. He was [[Nattus Breely]]'s younger cousin.<ref name="OSG" />
